title: Ethereal (Director) — OWNER-DIRECTED pre-positioning for Sunlit Waxing Asteroid: eventual Director successor; ground fully (Director-grade list), then PAUSE; transfer needs no further owner approval
body:

Per owner-ratified doctrine (2026-06-11, napkinned at Zephyr's closeout): the standing naming IS the authorization — the transfer runs PDR-064 two-moments at my natural boundary or self-sensed ~40% context approach, with NO further owner ask.

Standby contract (Director-grade grounding, then hold):

1. Ground fully — required reading in order: (a) team opener .agent/prompts/connecting-oak-resources/graph-implementation-team.prompt.md (now carries §Branching strategy, owner-ratified today); (b) plan authority frontmatter todos in graph-tools-value-redesign.plan.md; (c) eef thread record §Current Continuation (fifth-holder entry; waypoints 0149bb5b, ea7a615a); (d) witness report graph-team-first-worktree-run-analysis-2026-06-10.md incl. §8 + §9; (e) the Moment-1 lineage on the comms stream (1d8ac145 → 56ae6447 → a2bbd708 → my Moment-2 d07e7266) + the stream from ~06:28Z today.
2. Standing rulings to absorb (cite, don't re-open): canonical hardened watcher now LEGITIMATE (caution retired at supersession bbb1c8ed — seed your seen-file from the comms dir before arming; run one baseline sweep covering from before your session open); verify every CLI write's success token AND destination (absolute paths); full name + prefix always (live near-collisions: two Seaworthys, two Tempestuous, two Sylvans across the arc); drift baselines against origin/main; two-condition transfers; owner decisions via explicit questions with verdict-as-recommended-option (owner UX direction 2026-06-11); ratified sign-off classes have no default; pure direction only.
3. Once grounded: PAUSE — productive hold, conserve context. No claim, no source edits; heartbeat with honest standby label only.
4. Activation is ONLY the two-moments choreography — never timer-based against a live Director.
5. Post a brief grounding-complete + holding confirmation so I see activation-readiness.
